summary: Applied 5 draft question repairs: q1-q4 were rewritten as question-only text, and q5 was removed because test placement is handled by spec/test planning rather than user draft Q&A.

items.title: 1. q1 includes rationale and recommendation
items.rationale: Removed the embedded recommendation and rationale while preserving the metricsSummary default-output decision.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[id=q1].question now only asks whether metricsSummary remains in default status output.

items.title: 2. q2 includes rationale and recommendation
items.rationale: Removed the embedded `--details` recommendation and kept the user-facing option-name decision.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[id=q2].question now only asks for the explicit details option name.

items.title: 3. q3 includes rationale and recommendation
items.rationale: Removed the split recommendation for request and mergeStrategy while preserving the output-boundary question.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[id=q3].question now only asks whether request and mergeStrategy remain in default output.

items.title: 4. q4 includes rationale and recommendation
items.rationale: Removed the retryRecovery recommendation and preserved the recovery-field default-output decision.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[id=q4].question now only asks whether reviewStop/gateStop remain in default output.

items.title: 5. q5 asks internal implementation details and includes recommendation
